reader.notes: The INVALID KEY branch tests only the 2x class and NOT INVALID KEY tests only 0x, so a 4x status skips both. EmitUseHook's __IoCheck call selects the file-name or open-mode declarative before control reaches the next statement. The witness and the probes agree, and no edition is consulted on this path.

NOT INVALID KEY on a file not open runs the containing program's GLOBAL USE (GUSE-RY 48), then IN-AFTER-48 48, with neither phrase run. A DELETE with no INVALID KEY on an absent record runs GUSE-RX 23 (the GR3 path).
